title: Getting Started with Acme SaaS
body:
Getting Started

Welcome to Acme SaaS. This guide walks you through your first project setup.

Step 1: Create a project

Click New Project in the dashboard and fill in a name and description.

Step 2: Invite your team

Go to Settings > Members and enter your teammates' email addresses.

Step 3: Add your first task

Inside the project, click Add Task, assign it to a team member, and set a due date.

title: How to Reset Your Password
body:
Password Reset

If you have forgotten your password, click Forgot Password on the login page.

A reset link will be emailed to your registered address and is valid for 24 hours.

Steps

  1. Go to app.acme-saas.com/login.
  2. Click Forgot your password? below the sign-in button.
  3. Enter your email address and click Send reset link.
  4. Check your inbox (and spam folder) for the email.
  5. Click the link and enter your new password twice to confirm.

If you do not receive the email within 5 minutes, check your spam or junk folder. Still nothing? Contact support@acme-saas.com.

title: Billing and Subscription Plans
body:
Billing

Acme SaaS offers three plans: Starter, Pro, and Enterprise.

  • Starter: up to 5 users, $49/month
  • Pro: up to 20 users, $149/month
  • Enterprise: unlimited users, custom pricing

All plans include a 14-day free trial. No credit card required.

Changing Your Plan

Go to Settings > Billing and click Change Plan. Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrades apply at the next billing cycle.

Invoices

Invoices are emailed to the billing contact each month and are also available under Settings > Billing > Invoices.

title: Exporting Your Data
body:
Data Export

You can export all project data as a CSV or JSON file.

Navigate to Settings > Data > Export and choose your format. Large exports may take a few minutes to prepare; you will receive an email with a download link when ready.

What is included

  • All projects, tasks, and subtasks
  • Team members and their roles
  • Comments and activity history
  • Attachments (as download URLs, valid for 7 days)

GDPR data export

Enterprise customers can request a full GDPR data export from Settings > Data > GDPR Export. The export is prepared within 72 hours.

title: API Keys and Authentication
body:
API Keys

Generate API keys under Settings > API. Each key is scoped to either read-only or read-write.

Include the key in the Authorization: Bearer <key> header on every request. Rotate keys immediately if they are ever exposed.

Rate limits

The API allows up to 1,000 requests per minute per key on Pro and Enterprise plans, and 100 requests per minute on Starter. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429. Use exponential back-off when retrying.

Webhooks vs. polling

For real-time events, set up a webhook endpoint instead of polling the API. Webhooks are configured under Settings > API > Webhooks.

title: Team Collaboration and Permissions
body:
Team Collaboration

Acme SaaS supports role-based access control so you can give each team member the right level of access.

Roles

  • Owner — full access, including billing and member management. One per account.
  • Admin — can manage members, projects, and settings but cannot change billing.
  • Member — can create and edit tasks in projects they are added to.
  • Viewer — read-only access to projects they are added to.

Inviting members

Go to Settings > Members > Invite, enter the email address, choose a role, and click Send Invite. The invitee will receive an email to accept the invitation.

Removing members

Go to Settings > Members, find the member, and click Remove. Their tasks are reassigned to the project owner.

title: Integrations Overview
body:
Integrations

Acme SaaS connects with the tools your team already uses.

Available integrations

  • Slack — get notifications and create tasks directly from Slack messages.
  • GitHub — link pull requests and issues to tasks automatically.
  • Google Calendar — sync task due dates to your calendar.
  • Zapier — connect to 5,000+ apps without writing code.
  • Jira — two-way sync for teams that use both platforms.

Setting up an integration

Go to Settings > Integrations, choose the integration you want, and follow the OAuth prompts. Most integrations are active within 30 seconds.

Disconnecting an integration

Go to Settings > Integrations, find the connected integration, and click Disconnect. Disconnecting does not delete any data in Acme SaaS.

title: Two-Factor Authentication
body:
Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)

Two-factor authentication adds a second layer of security to your account. We strongly recommend enabling it.

Enabling 2FA

  1. Go to Settings > Security.
  2. Click Enable Two-Factor Authentication.
  3. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, or 1Password).
  4. Enter the 6-digit code from your app to confirm setup.
  5. Save your backup codes in a secure place — they are shown only once.

Logging in with 2FA

After entering your password, you will be prompted for the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. Codes refresh every 30 seconds.

Lost access to your authenticator?

Use one of your backup codes to log in. If you have lost both your authenticator and backup codes, contact support@acme-saas.com and we will verify your identity before resetting 2FA.

title: Webhook Configuration
body:
Webhooks

Webhooks let your application receive real-time notifications when events happen in Acme SaaS.

Creating a webhook

  1. Go to Settings > API > Webhooks.
  2. Click Add Webhook.
  3. Enter the endpoint URL where you want to receive events.
  4. Select the event types to subscribe to (e.g., task.created, task.completed, comment.added).
  5. Click Save. We will send a test ping to verify the endpoint is reachable.

Security

Each webhook request includes an X-Acme-Signature header — an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the request body using your webhook secret. Verify this signature on your server before processing the payload.

Retries

If your endpoint returns a non-2xx response, we retry up to 5 times with exponential back-off. After 5 failures, the webhook is automatically disabled and you will receive an email alert.

title: Data Retention and Deletion
body:
Data Retention

Acme SaaS retains your data for as long as your account is active. When you delete a project or account, data is removed according to the schedule below.

Deleted projects

When you delete a project, all tasks, comments, and attachments within it are moved to a soft-delete state and permanently deleted after 30 days. You can restore a deleted project within this window from Settings > Deleted Projects.

Account cancellation

When you cancel your subscription, your data is retained for 90 days in case you reactivate. After 90 days it is permanently purged from all systems including backups.

GDPR right to erasure

To request immediate deletion of all your data, go to Settings > Data > Delete My Data or email privacy@acme-saas.com. We will confirm deletion within 30 days as required by GDPR Article 17.

title: Single Sign-On (SSO) Setup
body:
Single Sign-On (SSO)

Enterprise customers can configure SSO so team members log in with their company identity provider (IdP) instead of a separate password.

Supported protocols

  • SAML 2.0
  • OIDC (OpenID Connect)

Supported identity providers

We have tested with Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, OneLogin, and Ping Identity. Any SAML 2.0 or OIDC-compliant IdP should work.

Setup steps

  1. Go to Settings > Security > Single Sign-On (Enterprise plans only).
  2. Download our Service Provider metadata XML or note the ACS URL and Entity ID.
  3. Create an app in your IdP using our metadata.
  4. Paste your IdP metadata URL or XML back into Acme SaaS and click Test & Save.
  5. Optionally enforce SSO so members can only log in via your IdP.

Contact support@acme-saas.com if you need help — we offer free SSO setup calls for Enterprise customers.

title: Using the Mobile App
body:
Mobile App

Acme SaaS is available as a native app for iOS and Android.

Download

  • iOS: Search for "Acme SaaS" in the App Store or visit the link in your account dashboard.
  • Android: Search for "Acme SaaS" in Google Play.

Logging in

Use the same email and password as the web app. If your account has 2FA or SSO enabled, those are supported on mobile too.

Offline mode

The mobile app caches your most recent projects and tasks for offline reading. Changes made offline are synced automatically when your connection is restored. Attachments and comments require an internet connection.

Notifications

Enable push notifications when prompted during onboarding. You can customize which events trigger notifications under Profile > Notifications in the mobile app.

title: Custom Domains and White-Labeling
body:
Custom Domains

Enterprise customers can serve the Acme SaaS dashboard from their own domain (e.g., work.yourcompany.com).

Requirements

  • Enterprise plan
  • Access to your domain's DNS settings

Setup

  1. Go to Settings > Custom Domain.
  2. Enter your desired subdomain (e.g., work.yourcompany.com).
  3. Add the provided CNAME record to your DNS. Propagation typically takes 5–30 minutes.
  4. Click Verify. We provision a TLS certificate automatically via Let's Encrypt.

Email branding

With a custom domain, system emails (invitations, notifications) are sent from noreply@yourcompany.com. You will need to add the SPF and DKIM records we provide to avoid spam filtering.

title: Notifications and Alerts
body:
Notifications

Acme SaaS sends notifications by email, in the app, and (optionally) via Slack or mobile push.

Email notifications

By default you receive emails for: task assignments, comments that mention you (@mention), tasks nearing their due date, and project status changes. Adjust these at Profile > Notification Preferences.

In-app notifications

The bell icon in the top navigation shows all recent activity. Click any notification to jump directly to the relevant task or comment.

Slack notifications

After connecting the Slack integration, you can choose which events are posted to a specific channel. Configure this under Settings > Integrations > Slack.

Notification digest

To reduce inbox noise, switch from real-time emails to a daily or weekly digest under Profile > Notification Preferences > Email Frequency.

title: Troubleshooting Common Issues
body:
Troubleshooting

Here are solutions to the most frequently reported issues.

I can't log in

  • Double-check your email address for typos.
  • Use Forgot Password to reset your password.
  • If your company uses SSO, you must log in via your identity provider, not the standard login form.
  • Check whether your account has been deactivated by contacting your account admin.

I'm not receiving emails

  • Check your spam/junk folder.
  • Add noreply@acme-saas.com to your email allowlist.
  • Ask your IT team if company email filtering is blocking our domain.

The dashboard is loading slowly

  • Try a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows, Cmd+Shift+R on Mac).
  • Clear your browser cache and cookies.
  • Try a different browser or incognito window.
  • Check our status page at status.acme-saas.com for any ongoing incidents.

A task or project is missing

Check Settings > Deleted Projects — it may have been accidentally deleted. If it was deleted more than 30 days ago it cannot be recovered.

Still stuck?

Contact support@acme-saas.com with your account email and a description of the problem. Include any browser console errors if possible.
